test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The lizard's light brown skin acts as __camouflage__ in the desert sand.
solution: The correct answer is: **Reveal** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Camouflage** means to hide or disguise by blending in with the surroundings. (परिवेश के साथ घुलमिलकर छिपना) • **Example**: *The soldier used natural foliage to camouflage himself in the dense forest.* • Marked option **Reveal **means to make something known or visible. (किसी चीज़ को ज्ञात या दृश्यमान बनाना) • **Example**: *The magician dramatically pulled back the curtain to reveal a stunning illusion.* • The sentence suggests that the lizard's skin helps it blend in with the desert sand, so the opposite of that would be to make it stand out. • So, the antonym for "camouflage" is "reveal". Thus, **option 3 **is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Clothed **means dressed or covered. (पहना हुआ या ढका हुआ) • **Mask **means to conceal or disguise. (छिपाना ) • **Vanishing **means disappearing or fading away. (लुप्त हो जाना या लुप्त हो जाना) 166:T976, The correct answer is: **Revenge**
